title: Inmarsat-C: NCS common channel with SafetyNET messages
description: A synthetic AOR-E NCS common channel (NCS 144) on 1541.450 MHz, carrier 700 Hz above the VFO centre, Es/N0 about 10 dB: bulletin board and signalling channel descriptor in every frame, filler packets, and three EGC messages from synthetic LESs - a two-packet METAREA 5 warning (LES 114, msg 4101), an all-ships call (LES 102, msg 77) and a coastal warning (NAVAREA 1, station A, subject B; LES 104, msg 9). Four frames, looped: after the first loop every EGC packet is a repeat and is suppressed. Expect Channel 'NCS common channel, NCS 144 (AOR-E)', three EGC events, and the talker 'Inmarsat AOR-E' (the satellite) at 70 deg.

title: Inmarsat-C: a weak LES TDM, 1.5 kHz off, with a FleetNET group call
description: A synthetic LES TDM of LES 102 (AOR-E) at 1539.615 MHz, carrier 1.5 kHz below the VFO centre, Es/N0 about 3.5 dB as the plugin measures it in the playback (a few dB above the decoding threshold): bulletin board, filler packets and a FleetNET group call (group 1234, LES 102, msg 300). Expect Channel 'LES TDM, LES 102 (AOR-E)', the carrier near -1500 Hz, one EGC event and the talker 'Inmarsat AOR-E' at 200 deg.
